wcu.feat4_desc: Every listing is checked and updated so you can enquire with confidence.

footer.tagline: Penang's most complete new launch platform — for every budget, every lifestyle, every stage of life.

ob.slide1_title: Your Luxury Property Journey Starts Here
ob.slide1_desc: Discover premium new launches across Penang Island and Seberang Perai — curated for every lifestyle and budget.
ob.slide1_f1_desc: Every new launch in Penang, verified and kept up to date.
ob.slide1_f2_desc: Stack up to 5 projects and compare specs, price, and facilities.
ob.slide1_f3_desc: Instant financing intelligence — monthly installments, legal fees, and net cash out.
ob.slide2_desc: Use the powerful filter system to narrow down by type, price, bedrooms, tenure, and more.
ob.slide2_f1_desc: Filter by property type, area, status, bedrooms, size, and completion year.
ob.slide2_f2_desc: Instantly narrow results to your exact budget — from starter condos to premium residences.
ob.slide2_f3_desc: Each project has a full cinematic detail page with gallery, facilities, location map, and floor plans.
ob.slide3_desc: Our Loan Calculator handles discount, rebate, legal fees, stamp duty, and MOT — giving you the true cost picture.
ob.slide3_f1_desc: Enter developer discounts and cashback to see your actual SPA price and savings.
ob.slide3_f2_desc: Switch between local and foreign buyer mode — MOT, levy, and state fees auto-calculate.
ob.slide3_f3_desc: Save your calculation and share it directly to your agent via WhatsApp.
ob.slide3_tip: 💡 Head to the Tools tab to access the full Loan Calculator dashboard.
ob.slide4_desc: Found something you love? Register interest directly from any project page — or reach out via WhatsApp for personalised advice.
ob.slide4_f1_desc: Submit your enquiry directly from any project detail page in seconds.
ob.slide4_f2_desc: Book a showroom visit directly from the project page — available where listed.
ob.slide4_f3_desc: Our agents listen first and match you with the right project for your needs.
ob.slide4_tip: 💡 Tap the phone FAB button on any project page to register interest or visit a showroom.
